name: e-invoicing-tr-packaging-type-codes
title: UBL-TR packaging type codes (e-Fatura)
description: The PackagingTypeCode values listed by GİB with Turkish names for package and container types on Turkish e-documents, each checked against the UBL-TR schematron PackageTypeCodeList. The guide allows other UNECE/CEFACT package codes when not in this list.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.13 Paket/Kap Cins Kodları), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (PackageTypeCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16: used for in_schematron

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish name as printed in the Paket/Kap Cins Kodları list.

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when PackageTypeCodeList in the UBL-TR schematron accepts the code.
